Get tools for a Commons 0.2.0 object

Source: R/tools-commons.R
tools_commons.Rd

Wraps the public $search() and $measure() methods of a model-free commons::commons() object (from commons 0.2.0 or later) as Deputy tools: commons_search and commons_measure. Call tools_commons() once and share the returned tools across a lead agent and its specialists so that a single commons_measure tool object acts as the producer for TrustedResults().

Neither SQL nor arbitrary R execution is exposed. When no approved measure matches a search, commons_search reports that no approved calculation covers the question.

Usage

tools_commons(commons)

Arguments

commons

A commons object created by commons::commons() (version 0.2.0 or later), without a chat client.

Value

A named list of two ellmer tools: commons_search and commons_measure.

Details

You remain responsible for creating and authorizing the commons object for the current viewer. Both returned tools are annotated as read-only and closed-world (read_only_hint = TRUE, destructive_hint = FALSE, open_world_hint = FALSE, idempotent_hint = TRUE) so they work in read-only policies and alongside TrustedResults() without mutating tool metadata. Deputy does not inspect what a measure function does internally, so pass only a commons object whose measures are read-only and authorized for the viewer.

Public Commons methods return R values rather than the native tool-result evidence that commons::agent() attaches to its own tool calls (such as commons_tag, compiled SQL, or bound query parameters). commons_measure wraps returned values in Deputy's bounded display cards and trusted-result receipts without fabricating query metadata or claiming native Commons card parity. Measures that return an ellmer::ContentToolResult keep their own value and display fields.

See also

TrustedResults(), tools_data(), tool_metadata()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cm <- commons::commons(
  data_sources = commons::data_source(sales = sales_df),
  semantic_layer = commons::semantic_layer(
    commons::measure("total_revenue", "Total revenue.", function() sum(sales_df$revenue))
  )
)
tools <- tools_commons(cm)
agent <- Agent$new(
  chat = ellmer::chat("anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5"),
  tools = tools,
  permissions = Permissions(mode = "readonly", tool_allowlist = names(tools)),
  trusted_results = TrustedResults(measure = tools$commons_measure)
)
} # }
